subject: general
question: John bought three items from a store. The price of item A was (2)/(3) of the price of item B, while the price of item C was (3)/(4) of the price of item B. If the price of item A was ₹88, then what was the price of item C?
solution:
Given:

The price of item A was (2)/(3) of the price of item B, while the price of item C was (3)/(4) of the price of item B.

The price of item A was ₹88

Calculation:

Let the price of item B be Q.

The price of item A = 2Q/3

The price of item C = 3Q/4

According to the question,

2Q/3 = 88

⇒ Q = (88 × 3)/2

⇒ Q = 132

Now,

3Q/4 = (3 × 132)/4

⇒ 99

**∴ The price of item C was ₹99.**

1c
